lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns posterior to the gills; a distinct triangular arrangement of three spots is visible superior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of spots to form a coordinate-like grid across the mid-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to and swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface and pectoral fin margin.
